binary.reason: Not applicable: src/wire.c decodes JSON frames, not WIRE-1 bitstrings, so there is no bit reader to extend. The blocker is zlib -- the encoder chooses per frame whether to compress the metadata -- and taking a compression dependency into a -std=c99 -pedantic microcontroller target is a decision about this SDK's footprint.

cli.reason: Python command line entry point; consumers expose idiomatic language APIs or MCP tools.

control.reason: Embedded C is a caller-buffer wire library without a control-plane HTTP client.

conversation.reason: Not applicable: thalovant_ask_request takes a session_id string, not a session, so there is nowhere to put converse_handlers and nothing to carry it into. The carry is a pure function and would port the day the C API accepts an opaque session object.

identity.reason: Caller owns credential storage; C consumes supplied keys and credentials.

inventory.reason: C has no managed inventory object model or filesystem cache; callers own parsing and storage.

listing.reason: C does not bundle the managed locale renderer or Unicode language tables.

mesh.reason: Not applicable: this SDK exposes the wire types but no subscription API; the caller polls and dispatches its own frames.

runtime.reason: The shared vectors reach C through a generated header -- there is no JSON parser here to read them at runtime -- and the generator is now their only author, checked against the vendored file by `make test`. It was transcribed by hand from a file this repository did not carry, so a changed expectation upstream had nothing here to notice it.

session.reason: Caller owns network connections, scheduling and callback lifetime; C does not manage hub sessions.
